title: Records concerning the proposed rescission of the 2001 Roadless Area Conservation Rule

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All records from the U.S. Forest Service concerning the proposal to rescind or revise the 2001 Roadless Area Conservation Rule, including the June 23, 2025 notice of intent and the August 20, 2026 proposed rulemaking and draft environmental impact statement. For all items below, "communications" and "correspondence" include emails, text messages, instant messages, and chat messages (such as Microsoft Teams or Slack), whether sent or received on government-issued or personal devices and accounts used for official business:

1. All communications, memoranda, briefing papers, and decision documents, dated June 1, 2025 to the present, (a) within the Forest Service, (b) between the Forest Service and the USDA Office of the Secretary, and (c) between Forest Service officials and White House or Executive Office of the President officials, concerning the proposed rescission. Please include records from the Office of the Chief, the National Forest System deputy area, and Ecosystem Management Coordination staff involved in the rulemaking. Suggested search terms: "Roadless Rule," "Roadless Area Conservation Rule," "rescission," "inventoried roadless areas," "DEIS."

2. All records reflecting the Forest Service's tabulation, analysis, or summary of public comments received in response to (a) the June 2025 notice of intent and (b) the August 2026 proposed rulemaking, including methodology documents, contractor reports or deliverables related to comment processing, and internal presentations summarizing comment results.

3. All briefing materials, talking points, and decision memoranda prepared for Forest Service or USDA leadership recommending a preferred alternative (including full rescission) in the draft EIS or proposed rule, dated January 1, 2026 to the present.

4. All correspondence (letters, emails, text and instant messages, chat messages, meeting notes or summaries) between Forest Service officials and non-governmental outside parties, including timber industry associations, trade groups, and state government officials, concerning the proposed rescission, dated June 1, 2025 to the present.

Please provide responsive records electronically (searchable PDF or native files). If any records are withheld in whole or in part, please identify each one, state the specific FOIA exemption claimed, and release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. I am willing to pay up to $50 in fees; please notify me in advance with an itemized estimate if charges will exceed that amount.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jeff

title: Hiring Board Records & Selection Metrics: Announcement ES_1786461208616 (AFLCMC/ESGH)

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Hiring Board Records & Selection Metrics: Announcement ES_1786461208616 (AFLCMC/ESGH)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

ATTN: Hill AFB FOIA Requester Service Center (66 ABG/CEOE) & Hanscom AFB FOIA Requester Service Center

ACTION REQUIRED: This request concerns a Geographically Separated Unit (AFLCMC/ESGH) located at Hill AFB, UT, reporting to a parent command (AFLCMC/ESG) at Hanscom AFB. Please route to both installations to prevent processing delays.

This is a request under the Freedom of Information Act. I am requesting records regarding the hiring action, evaluation process, and selection board metrics for position announcement tracking number ES_1786461208616, for the NH-04 Deputy Branch Chief / Chief of Logistics position within the AFLCMC/ESGH Branch. AFLCMC/ESGH operates as a Geographically Separated Unit (GSU) located at Hill Air Force Base, UT, under the organizational structure of AFLCMC/ESG based at Hanscom Air Force Base.
The hiring board for this action was comprised of Patrik Caron, Brendan Shaw, and Joey Wilkinson.
To narrow the scope and ensure a prompt response, I am requesting the following specific agency records associated with this announcement:
1. Position Requirements & Minimum Certifications:
	• The formal core personnel document (CPD), position description (PD), and specific evaluation criteria used by the board to determine minimum eligibility.
	• Please explicitly include the mandated thresholds for:
		• Minimum formal educational degrees or equivalent.
		• Time-in-Grade (TIG) restrictions or equivalent corporate experience required for an NH-04 appointment.
		• Required Professional Military Education (PME) levels.
		• Defense Acquisition University (DAU) / Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Lifecycle Logistics certification levels (e.g., Back-to-Basics foundational or advanced tiers).
2. Anonymized Selection & Interview Statistics:
	• The total number of applicants who submitted packages for listing ES_1786461208616.
	• The total number of applicants determined by Human Resources to meet the basic qualifications.
	• The total number of applicants who were referred to the hiring board and subsequently selected for an interview.
3. Board Evaluation, Grading Matrices, and Scoreheets:
	• All blank templates, scorecards, evaluation rubrics, and grading sheets utilized by panel members Patrik Caron, Brendan Shaw, and Joey Wilkinson to rate candidates during the interview and portfolio review phases.
	• All anonymized, completed grading sheets, master tally sheets, ranking rosters, or merit promotion certificates generated by the board. (Note: To protect personal privacy under Exemption 6, applicant names may be redacted and replaced with anonymous identifiers, e.g., "Candidate A," "Candidate B").
4. Selection Justification & Discrepancy Records:
	• The final selection justification memo or formal recommendation signed by the board members detailing the rationale for the final selection.
	• Any memoranda, emails, or internal board correspondence discussing adjustments to scores, exceptions made for certification shortfalls, or tie-breaking justifications where a candidate with less seniority, lower DAU certification levels, or fewer baseline qualifications was selected over higher-scoring or more experienced applicants on the referral list.

Fee Waiver & Processing:
I request that all processing fees be waived as this matter directly concerns the transparency, fairness, and administrative integrity of civil service hiring practices within Air Force Materiel Command. If fees cannot be waived, please notify me if costs are projected to exceed $25.00.
If any portion of this request is withheld under a dynamic interpretation of FOIA exemptions, please release all reasonably segregable, non-exempt portions.
Thank you for your time and assistance. I look forward to your prompt response within the statutory 20-business-day window.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FEDERAL ACQUISITION & LOGISTICS WATCH
